Intel: chunk multi-function Python source into multiple pieces

```python title="Python"

def main() -> None:
    source = "def alpha():\n    pass\n\ndef beta():\n    pass\n\ndef gamma():\n    pass\n\ndef delta():\n    pass\n"
    config = {"chunk_max_size": 30, "language": "python"}
```
